description: This file defines API routes for managing dashboard configurations in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for saving, listing, and retrieving dashboard configurations, utilizing async database operations and WebSocket broadcasting.

classes.name: DashboardConfig
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the structure of a dashboard configuration, including its ID and settings.

classes.name: DashboardSummary
classes.description: Pydantic model summarizing basic dashboard info such as ID and title.

methods.name: save_dashboard_config( config: DashboardConfig, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to save or update a dashboard configuration in the database and broadcast the update to connected clients.

methods.name: list_dashboards( db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to list all dashboards owned by the current user, returning their IDs and titles.

methods.name: get_dashboard_config( dashboard_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific dashboard configuration by ID, ensuring ownership.

ctags.name: config
ctags.pattern: /^    config: Dict[str, Any] = Field(..., description="Dashboard configuration (structure, widgets/

ctags.name: dashboard_id
ctags.pattern: /^    dashboard_id: str = Field(..., description="Unique dashboard identifier")$/

ctags.name: get_dashboard_config
ctags.signature: ( dashboard_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )

ctags.name: save_dashboard_config
ctags.signature: ( config: DashboardConfig, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
